context: A uni student debates a teacher on capital punishment
purpose: Teach: 控訴/死刑/大蔵省/認可/勧告/侵略/貧困/殺さ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、僕はやっぱり死刑制度には反対です。国家が人を殺すなんて、結局は侵略国家と同じ論理じゃないですか。
lines.en: Teacher, I'm still opposed to the death penalty. A state killing people follows the same logic as an aggressor nation, doesn't it?
lines.style: Earnest, slightly confrontational university student making a moral argument.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 面白い視点ね。でも侵略戦争と国内の刑罰を同列に語るのは少し乱暴じゃない?被害者遺族の感情も考えなきゃ。
lines.en: Interesting angle. But equating wars of aggression with domestic punishment is a bit reckless, no? You have to consider the victims' families.
lines.style: Calm, measured teacher pushing back with a counter-question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも冤罪のケースもあります。控訴審でひっくり返った例だってある。一度殺されたら取り返しがつかないんですよ。
lines.en: But there are wrongful convictions. There are cases overturned at the appeals court. Once someone is killed, there's no undoing it.
lines.style: Passionate rebuttal citing concrete legal evidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 確かにそれは重い指摘ね。国連からも何度か勧告が出ているのは事実だし。
lines.en: That's certainly a weighty point. It's true the UN has issued recommendations on this several times too.
lines.style: Conceding partially, acknowledging international pressure thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それに、貧困層ほど十分な弁護を受けられず重い判決になりやすい。社会の構造そのものが歪んでるんです。
lines.en: And the poorer classes can't get adequate legal defense and end up with harsher sentences. The very structure of society is warped.
lines.style: Expanding argument into social inequality with growing conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昔、旧大蔵省の役人が司法改革の予算を渋ったって話もあるわ。制度の認可や運用は政治に左右されるのよね。
lines.en: There's a story that old Ministry of Finance officials once balked at funding judicial reform. Authorization and operation of the system is swayed by politics.
lines.style: Sharing historical institutional knowledge to deepen the discussion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほら、やっぱり制度自体に欠陥があるんです。だから僕は死刑廃止の立場を譲れません。
lines.en: See, the system itself is flawed. That's why I can't back down from the abolitionist position.
lines.style: Triumphant, holding firm on his principled stance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい議論だったわ、レン君。来週はこのテーマでレポート書いてみない?あなたの主張、きちんと読みたいから。
lines.en: That was a good debate, Ren. Why don't you write a report on this topic next week? I'd really like to read your argument properly.
lines.style: Warm teacher closing with encouragement and academic challenge.
